bundle.shortDescription: Maps ALPR camera locations from OpenStreetMap
bundle.longDescription: Flock Finder maps publicly sited automated license plate reader cameras using crowdsourced OpenStreetMap data. Coverage is incomplete; absence of a marker does not mean absence of a camera.
